_doc: TERMS-CROSSWALK-1 (owner directive 2026-11-12): words people and agents use for overlapping ideas, each mapped to one canonical glossary term. Checked by `python3 -m foundation crosswalk --check`; consumed by tests/foundation/test_crosswalk.py.
marker_text: TERMS-CROSSWALK: say autonomous for a system with self-referential loops and the ability to close them (glossary `autonomy`); closed loop for one loop that its own system closes (`loop`, `self-referential-closure`); automatic only for one step that code runs with no person (a property of a step, never of a system). Do not use unattended, never-terminating, hands-off or set-and-forget as synonyms. Map and avoided words: doctrine/crosswalk.json (`python3 -m foundation crosswalk --check`).

entries.means: self-referential loops plus the ability to close them
entries.not: running without people; not a single automated step

entries.means: a loop whose trigger, action, verification and write-back the system itself runs
entries.not: a loop a person must close

entries.means: one step executed by code with no person; a property of a step
entries.not: autonomy; many automatic steps do not make a system autonomous

entries.means: the heartbeat always pulls the next item; stops only at the interrupt gate
entries.not: an unbounded process with no stop condition

entries.means: no human step except an irreversible, identity-bound act, which becomes a gate card with a default in effect
